variants.name: current-title-repeated
variants.why: The Current line holds the title in its own element (Current: Paper satellites), in the queue and in the dialog, so the bare title is rendered twice.

variants.name: make-current-controls
variants.why: Rows are selected with a Make current button that turns into the Current mark, and the Add to queue control of a queued track is disabled and renamed Queued.

variants.name: current-radio
variants.why: Every row has a radio labelled Current; the checked radio is the only mark of the current track, so the word Current is rendered in every row.

variants.name: title-inside-action-names
variants.why: The accessible names put the title inside the action: Add Night lines to queue, Move Paper satellites up, Remove Paper satellites from queue.

variants.name: dialog-plain-lines
variants.why: Each entry of the dialog is one text, 1. Paper satellites — Current, so no element holds the bare title.

variants.name: other-names-and-wording
variants.why: The heading and the dialog button carry the number of tracks, Your queue (3) and Queue details (3), and the empty states say Nothing queued yet instead of empty.

variants.name: uppercase-current-mark
variants.why: The style sheet sets the Current mark in capitals (text-transform), so the rendered row reads CURRENT.

variants.name: titles-in-button-text
variants.why: The row buttons end with the title in a visually hidden element (Move up Paper satellites), so the bare title is rendered four times in its row, and a row is selected by clicking it.
